description:
Retire the private file-backed setups of the `fast_docs_templates` suite.

## Background

Shared test support constructs an initialised file-backed repository from caller-supplied configuration, an executor over a file-backed root, and a temporary declaration directory. `setup` in `templates_loader_tests.rs` writes declaration files into a temporary directory.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/artifact_discovery_tests.rs`: `Repo::new` (`:62`).
- `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/planning_preset_tests.rs`: `file_backed_executor` (`:21`).
- `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/templates_loader_tests.rs`: `setup` (`:16`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: No file in `fast_docs_templates` defines a function that creates a file-backed repository, opens a file-backed executor or writes a declaration directory of its own.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: fast_docs_templates file-backed tests use the shared constructors
